paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -6.44% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (-2.26%) and Nasdaq weakest (-10.02%). Brent crude changed -6.23% to 89.87. Gold changed -8.94% to 3,539.0. Bitcoin changed -9.50% to 59,103.6719. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.912%, a relative move of -4.70%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (-22.37%) and Newmont (-16.32%) moved the most.
